behavior: A click on `Combobox.Label` focuses the control of its root: the input, or the trigger while the input is inside the popup. The id of the trigger element does not matter. Base UI finds the trigger by an id: the control id of the field, or the id of the trigger element with no field. A custom element of the trigger can give another id. In a field, the click then focuses nothing when that id differs from the control id of the field. With no field, the click focuses nothing when the id is empty.
